role: Read-only validator of Co-Being mathematical and morphological results against Python ground truth
detail: Exports ValidationExecutor class (async validators for math and morphology) and ValidationResult dataclass. Math validation uses operator module dispatch table (add, subtract, multiply, successor, predecessor, compare_eq/gt/lt) with fixed operand counts; morphological validation uses inflect library for pluralize, plural, present_participle, past_tense. Confidence adjustment: +0.05 on correct, -0.10 on incorrect (asymmetric to reflect pedagogical value of errors). No eval() or exec() — security enforced via template-based dispatch. Inflect library optional; graceful fallback to inflect_unavailable validation_source. Validation results flow into edge confidence adjustments and DOES_NOT_COMPUTE_TO negative knowledge edges, never inject new COMPUTES_TO edges (CANON A.1 compliance).
gotchas: past_tense marked as not natively in inflect and handled specially (line 149), but no special handling visible in code; inflect library import failure silently disables morphological validation (safe fallback); morphological validation assumes correct when inflect unavailable (lines 336, 353, 368, 388) rather than failing conservatively — could mask errors if library missing in validation path
